readerCopy.body: A feeling contained for years changes the terms of the entire conversation. Grief, resentment, fear, or a family secret surfaces during a decision that can no longer proceed as though the history were irrelevant. The Moon drags the buried emotional record into the room, while Pluto exposes how silence and control shaped the conflict. Under the conjunction, the disclosure and the shift in power happen together. The truth may bring relief while permanently changing who is trusted and what can remain unspoken.
